description: Fetch daily download counts for a PyPI package — up to 100 days, with total, latest day and average over days that have data; days without collection are null with a note. Read-only aggregation of daily-collected observatory data; no side effects. Days inside the PyPI reporting delay are partial (shown, excluded from latest and average), never fake zeros. Use when the user asks how a PyPI package is growing; for side-by-side comparison use `get_package_comparison`.
name: get_pypi_trends
title: Get Pypi Trends
